verdict.rationale: Controlling whether customer data is used for AI training is a fair privacy question for a SaaS marketing platform that ships AI features. However, no evidence in the pack documents any AI-training opt-out or data-usage policy. The pack only covers email features, AI content features and an MCP server, and none of these address training on customer data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
